question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.

-- Final query with integer casts
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.over_id,
        CAST(SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS INTEGER) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
over_bowler AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, bowler,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no, over_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
    FROM ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id, bowler
),
over_with_bowler AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.innings_no, o.over_id, o.total_runs, ob.bowler
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN over_bowler ob ON o.match_id = ob.match_id AND o.innings_no = ob.innings_no AND o.over_id = ob.over_id AND ob.rn = 1
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_with_bowler
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_over_overs AS (
    SELECT owb.match_id, owb.innings_no, owb.over_id, owb.total_runs, owb.bowler
    FROM over_with_bowler owb
    JOIN max_runs_per_match mpm ON owb.match_id = mpm.match_id
    WHERE owb.total_runs = mpm.max_runs
),
bowler_max AS (
    SELECT bowler, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs_in_max_over
    FROM max_over_overs
    GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, bmm.match_id, bmm.total_runs as runs_conceded
FROM bowler_max t
JOIN (
    SELECT bowler, total_runs, match_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY total_runs DESC, match_id ASC) as rn
    FROM max_over_overs
) bmm ON t.bowler = bmm.bowler AND t.max_runs_in_max_over = bmm.total_runs AND bmm.rn = 1
JOIN player p ON t.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY t.max_runs_in_max_over DESC
LIMIT 3;

    FROM max_over_overs
    GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, bmm.match_id, bmm.total_runs as runs_conceded
FROM bowler_max t
JOIN (
    SELECT bowler, total_runs, match_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY total_runs DESC, match_id ASC) as rn
    FROM max_over_overs
) bmm ON t.bowler = bmm.bowler AND t.max_runs_in_max_over = bmm.total_runs AND bmm.rn = 1
JOIN player p ON t.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY t.max_runs_in_max_over DESC
LIMIT 3;
